title: Prime Minister remembers Swami Vivekananda’s historic address in Chicago
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi has remembered Swami Vivekananda’s historic address in Chicago delivered on 11th September 1893. The Prime Minister said that Swami Vivekananda’s captivating address offered a glimpse of the civilisational ethos of India. Shri Modi said that his inspiring words still reverberate across the world. The Prime Minister wrote on X; “11th September 1893, Chicago. Swami Vivekananda’s captivating address offered a glimpse of the civilisational ethos of India.
